_comment: The server switcher's monogram rule, as literal cases: the name, its letters, its colour. Go (internal/ui serverMonogram, serverMonogramColour; TestTheMonogram) and the script (web/static/servers.js monogram, monogramColour; e2e/servers.test.mjs) are both held to this one table. The colours were computed apart from either implementation (32-bit FNV-1a over the name's UTF-16 code units, modulo the eight-colour palette).
